articles.title_original: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
articles.title_zh: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
facts_zh:
Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
- Published
Hundreds of French supermarkets have been hit by a cyber attack that caused their fridges and freezers to heat up, spoiling fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.
Hackers gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units, forcing some to warm to 50C (120F) overnight, according to one supermarket chain affected.
The chief executive of Coopérative U said several of its supermarkets had been hit by the "extremely serious and unprecedented" attack.

all_titles.en: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack

articles.title_original: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
articles.title_zh: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
facts_zh:
Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
- Published
Russia struck six Ukrainian energy facilities hours after US President Donald Trump announced the two countries had agreed to an energy ceasefire, Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
Despite Trump stating on Sunday the truce would be "effective immediately", the Ukrainian president said Russia had hit "our gas stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities".

There were blackouts in the city of Izyum after a Russian strike destroyed power grids, Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform said, while energy and railway infrastructure in western Ukraine was also targeted overnight.

articles.title_zh: Thousands march to Indian Supreme Court to demand election chief resign
facts_zh:
Thousands march to Indian Supreme Court to demand election chief resign
- Published
Thousands of opposition supporters marched through Delhi to India's Supreme Court to demand the election chief resign over alleged electoral roll fraud.
Monday's "March for Democracy" was the latest in a series of demonstrations, with thousands of security forces deployed and roads barricaded in the capital.
Thousands of protesters were detained over the weekend.

facts_zh: Clear skies bring warm days and cold nights to Montenegro, while a low-pressure system moves towards Aegean Sea Europe live – latest updates Temperatures fluctuated dramatically in the Balkans last week, with unusually large differences between daytime highs and overnight lows – known as the diurnal range.

An area of high pressure over the region brought prolonged sunshine during the day, while clear skies at night allowed temperatures to drop rapidly as heat escaped into the atmosphere without cloud cover to slow the cooling.
